protocol.comparator: Reimplementation of Zarate-Aranda and Ortiz-Bayliss (2025) under the existing Jooken protocol
protocol.feature_scaling: Instance normalization only; no dataset standardization or fitted scaling

inference.contrasts: Each of the four selected formulae minus kNN on ID
inference.estimand: Mean paired gap difference; group resampling only, conditional on fixed selected models
inference.interval: Percentile bootstrap, linear quantiles .00625 and .99375; Bonferroni-adjusted 98.75% for four two-sided contrasts

protocol.labels: Maximum packed integer profit from original decoder and rules; equal-profit tie order DEF, MAXP, MAXPW, MINW
protocol.loss: 1000000*(certified optimum - integer packed profit)/certified optimum; lower is better
protocol.neighbor_ties: R class::knn use.all=TRUE includes all boundary-distance ties; equal winning class votes use R seeded random tie resolution
protocol.prediction_order: One call for all 1594 test instances, ascending ASCII instance name; training also ascending ASCII name
prohibited: alteration of original permutation, unresolved-case, or Pisinger analyses
protocol.scope_limit: Published training distribution was class-balanced synthetic data. This study uses the same unbalanced 1383 Jooken development cases as final GEP training, without rebalancing. It does not reproduce the published benchmark or claim a universal comparison.
protocol.status: fixed before new test evaluation; not part of the original confirmatory protocol
protocol.study: Revision-stage comparison conditional on four previously development-selected GEP formulae
protocol.undefined_correlation: rho=0, hence correlation feature=0.5; record a flag; clip finite rho to [-1,1] for rounding
